description: Single source of truth for closed-loop skill-suite enums (sentinel / tuning-memory / optimizer-loop). quality_gate.mjs of all three skills MUST read literals from this file; python side mirrors via closedloop_common/enums.py. Changing a literal here = breaking contract, bump contract_version of affected artifact.
responsibility_rule: IDD is a PURE ANALYSIS system (v1.4 user ruling): it produces analysis artifacts with evidence grades and NEVER dispatches parameters or makes control decisions. Evidence grade = advisory strength for the consumer, NOT an authorization level. Whether/how to act (suggest-approve-auto dispatch policy) is decided entirely by the AWS side; the former IDD-side autonomy enum is retired to AWS concern.

evidence_grades.E0: weak: retro-mined | attribution_status=truncated | confound_detected | attribution_compromised | direction_uncertain — advisory strength: reference only
evidence_grades.E1: observed: single estimable attribution (CI may cross 0)
evidence_grades.E2: confirmed: same-regime corroboration_count>=2 (RAG verified) AND ci95 excludes 0 AND confound_detected=false
evidence_grades.E3: cross_regime: E2 AND cross_regime_consistent (>=2 regime_key with same direction)

tuning_memory.admission_rule: local experience store admits ONLY entries whose attribution_report passed schema validation AND attribution_status != not_estimable (E0 retro entries allowed as observation-grade); KB ingestion is NOT done by IDD — AWS agent ingests kb-ready summaries via rag-bridge kb_agent with regime_key scenario title (three-system split: AWS orchestrates, IDD analyzes, KB stores/retrieves)

optimizer.convergence: dual gate (USER DECISION 2026-10-01): m>=3 confirm replicates all inside target_range AND one-sided 95% CI within limits AND desirability D(x)>=0.8*D_max

ack.rule: recommendation without ack within timeout -> unconfirmed, excluded from corroboration promotion; executed action MUST be written back as action_log with actor_type=aws_executor and recommendation_id reference

inbox.error_receipt: {original_name}.error.json with human-readable Chinese error + fix guidance, original moved to _rejected/
inbox.auth: top-level auth.api_key field OR X-API-Key header; validated by scanner, invalid envelope rejected to _rejected/
